item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Sep 20
item.description:
17 development commits

Base Building

  • Building is now blocked within a radius of sandbag pillboxes, preventing structures from being placed directly on or too close to them.

Livestock & Animals

  • Sheep automatically unlead when mounted and re‑lead after dismount, with updated mount/dismount animations.

Item Durability

  • Condition (durability) has been disabled for diving masks, crate & barrel costumes, prisoner hoods, sunglasses, geiger counters, metal detectors, RF pagers, and mobile phones, so these items no longer degrade.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Sep 19
item.description:
16 development commits

Livestock & Animal Behavior

  • Leading livestock now works reliably and shows a visible rope.
  • Livestock headbutt damage increased; bulls no longer attack in safe zones; leading bulls stop fighting others; grazing through walls fixed; stop‑leading prompt bug fixed.
  • Livestock avoidance speed doubled, making them steer away from obstacles faster.
  • Bulls no longer attempt headbutts on unreachable players.
  • Animals no longer get stuck circling obstacles when fleeing or charging.

UI & Store

  • Store no longer shows a 'content failed to load' error when your inventory is empty.
